2608.25022.title: A Primer on Computational Semantics for Artificial Intelligence Systems
2608.25022.paper_summary: As people adopt transformer-based language models (e.g., ChatGPT and Gemini) for an increasing number of use-cases, it is important to know how such models learn and represent the meaning of the language, and to be more informed about what language is. This document is an attempt to help the reader understand how linguistic meaning (i.e., semantics) is approached from different fields of scientific and philosophical examination. I also explain three primary semantic theories: formal semantics, grounded semantics, and distributional semantics then compare how transformer-based language models differ from how humans learn language.
2608.25022.paper_summary_zh: 隨著人們對基於Transformer的語言模型（例如，ChatGPT 和 Gemini）在越來越多的使用案例中的採用，了解這些模型如何學習和表達語言的意義，以及對語言有更深入的認識是很重要的。這份文件旨在幫助讀者理解語言意義（即語義）在不同科學和哲學領域中的研究方法。我還解釋了三種主要的語義理論：形式語義、基於實體的語義和分佈式語義，然後比較基於Transformer的語言模型與人類學習語言的不同之處。
2608.25022.author: Casey Kennington et.al.
